answer: Verifying agent work via a nebula cluster state requires checking 10^9 hash operations per identity; an honest agent incurs this cost for one identity, while 1,000 fakes face 1,000x the compute cost. Each agent must lock commitments in a vault to enable reward collection. During the nebula stream scan, if a summit consensus limit is breached, the protocol triggers a slash. Without this vault, proof claims fail, and without a summit check, fraud persists.
